items.prompt: A plain room with a table, a chair, books and a window, but it feels as cold as a refrigerator: frost creeping across the window panes from the inside, the breath of a visitor visible in the air. A very old man sits at the table drinking tea mechanically, his face in shadow.

alt.ru: Обычная комната со столом, книгами и окном: изнутри по стёклам ползёт иней, у гостя изо рта идёт пар; очень старый человек пьёт чай.
alt.en: A plain room with a table, books and a window: frost creeping across the panes from inside, a visitor's breath visible; a very old man drinking tea.
alt.pt: Uma sala simples com mesa, livros e janela: geada cobrindo os vidros por dentro, o hálito de um visitante visível; um homem muito velho bebendo chá.
alt.es: Una sala sencilla con mesa, libros y ventana: escarcha cubriendo los cristales por dentro, el aliento de un visitante visible; un hombre muy viejo bebiendo té.
